item.title: Tinubu Reacts To Death Of Nollywood Veteran Richard Duru
item.dc:creator: Leadership
item.description: President Bola Tinubu has mourned veteran Nollywood actor Richard Francis Duru, who died at the age of 57. The President extended his condolences to Duru’s family, colleagues, fans and the Nigerian film industry, describing his death as a painful loss to the country’s creative community.
